notes.title: The Storyteller's Festival
notes.notes:
[b]Moonbriar[/b] (and a variety of other incredible narrative games) will be featured in the [b]2024 Storytellers Festival[/b] which begins on January 29th! The Storyteller's Festival is a celebration of games that put the focus on a narrative experience. Check out the [i]#TheStorytellersFestival[/i] hashtag on Twitter and see and support other indie games in development. Every wishlist and share can mean the world to me and these other developers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44010489/a815c65b9ccf40f59ab1cad72c69f3b9946ef5a2.png[/img]

Have questions? Feedback? Or would you like to pass on your thoughts? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/kdhP7HTzyF]Discord[/url]. I look forward to seeing you all there!

notes.title: Alpha Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
I am very excited to announce you can now visit the dark but beautiful world of [b]Moonbriar[/b]. Get to know the many characters, explore new locations, and discover how it all begins as part of the Alpha Demo. Available during the [b]Steam Visual Novel Festival[/b] running between [b]August 7th - 14th[/b]. Begin your story today! And feel free to share your feedback, ideas, or bug reports on our [url=https://discord.gg/kdhP7HTzyF]Discord[/url].
